speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing hand tremors and recent memory issues; please tell me, how long have these symptoms been present?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details; the progressive worsening of the left-hand tremor and new memory issues suggest a neurodegenerative process. To differentiate between Parkinson's disease and dementia with Lewy bodies, have you noticed any episodes where he becomes suddenly confused, hallucinates, or experiences a drop in alertness?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Resting tremor worse on the left hand. I also have Soft speech, Reduced facial expressions, Memory decline, Difficulty in managing finances.

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of a resting tremor, soft speech (hypophonia), reduced facial expressions (mask-like facies), and difficulty managing finances strongly points toward Parkinson's disease with cognitive involvement. To confirm this and rule out other causes, I need to see the brain structure and check dopamine levels. REQUEST IMAGES: Brain_MRI. REQUEST TEST: DaTscan.
